integrity: The displayed probability is a proved finite-model identity conditional on the specified initial state and transition rule; the limiting Dirichlet statement conditions on joint survival.
scientific_limitations: Complete and homogeneous agent communication; star opinion compatibility; unbiased pairwise imitation; one initial agent per peripheral opinion. The general exit law is analytically proved but unindexed multitype branching literature could contain a stronger theorem. Finite checks are not a substitute for the proof. No independent scientific assessment has been performed.
title: Uniform coexistence compositions for sparse peripheral opinions in a star voter model
